## LLM001 Model call inside @Transactional

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/事务里调模型拖垮连接池 |
| Turn it off | `LLM001: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM001` on the command line |

While the transaction waits for the model, this thread keeps a database connection checked out for those seconds. A pool holds only a few dozen connections; under load the first error is "cannot get a connection", not "the model is slow".

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM001` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm001 -->

## What it looks like

`@Transactional` on a method that calls `chatModel.call(...)` or `chatClient.prompt().call()`.

## How to fix

Load and save first, run the model call outside the transaction. If the answer must land together with the data, wrap only the insert in a `TransactionTemplate`.
